title: Test Real-Time Availability Update on Rent Creation
gherkin:
Feature: Real-Time Availability Update
  Scenario: User creates a new rent record
    Given an item is available for rent
    When a user creates a rent record for the item
    Then the availability status of the item should be updated to unavailable for the rent period
rationale: To ensure that the system updates the availability status in real time when a rent record is created, preventing misleading information.
usedContextItems: The system shall update availability in real time when rent records are created, modified, cancelled, or completed.|The system shall return availability status indicating whether the item is available or unavailable for the requested period.
generationSummary: This document outlines Gherkin tests for the requirement of separating availability state semantics to ensure clarity in item availability status for users.
resolvedOperativeContext: Records that are no longer operationally valid are being surfaced through the same availability wording used for temporarily blocked items, which may mislead users about whether the item is recoverable or simply not rentable at the moment. || The system shall update availability in real time when rent records are created, modified, cancelled, or completed. || The system shall return availability status indicating whether the item is available or unavailable for the requested period. || The system shall allow users to query item availability for a specified date range. || The system shall ensure availability queries reflect the latest rent and item status information. || The system shall allow authorized users to define availability restrictions for items. || The system shall calculate item availability based on existing rent records.
resolvedConflictsOrObsolete: Ambiguity in query results after recent item-management changes may mislead users about item availability.
resolutionNotes: Filtered abstract or low-relevance operative statements: The system shall mark an item as unavailable for any period where an Active or Approved rent exists. | The system shall ensure that availability calculation prevents overlapping rent periods. | The system shall prevent rent creation during restricted periods.
